findings.title: Radar lacks visual feedback (sweep/contacts)
findings.problem: Radar is a solid black disc with green center, no rotating sweep line or dots for visible contacts
findings.why: Players can't tell if radar is functional or track enemies, hurting situational awareness
findings.fix: Add a thin white sweep line rotating clockwise and small white dots for visible contacts

findings.title: Constructor input placeholder low contrast
findings.problem: Placeholder text is light gray, blending with dark input background
findings.why: Players can't easily read what to type, causing confusion
findings.fix: Change placeholder color to light blue (higher contrast with dark background)

findings.title: "Not road-legal" text readability
findings.problem: Orange "Not road-legal" text is small and low contrast against dark background
findings.why: Players might miss critical status, leading to confusion about vehicle legality
findings.fix: Increase font size by 20% and use a brighter orange (#FFA500) with a subtle dark outline

findings.title: Speedometer numerical value contrast
findings.problem: "0 mph" text is white but low contrast against dark speedometer background
findings.why: Players can't quickly check speed at a glance, hurting gameplay readability
findings.fix: Use bright white (#FFFFFF) with a thin light gray border around the number

findings.title: Menu unselected option contrast
findings.problem: "Controls" option is in a dark bar with low contrast against background
findings.why: Players can't distinguish unselected options, making menu navigation unclear
findings.fix: Use a lighter gray background for unselected menu items (e.g., #333333) to improve contrast
